selections.comment: Drifts Away is bidding to complete the four-timer after his victory at Chelmsford last month, but has another 3lb to contend with. With that in mind, GIORGIO M gets the vote. How Impressive has Oisin Murphy back in the plate and is another to note.

selections.comment: Lil Guff returned to action to score at Bath last week and based on that performance, she ought to go close. However, TOURIST struck at the same venue by a length when making his first start for the Robert Cowell yard and only has a 6lb higher mark to contend with. If the four-year-old can run at a similar level, he could prove tough to beat. Sugar Hill Babe completes the shortlist.

selections.comment: RUSSIAN CRESCENDO signed off her 2024 campaign with a victory at Ascot, which made it two wins out of three starts. The daughter of Cracksman could have lots more to offer this year and can defy an opening mark of 84. The main threat might be Orchard Keeper, who made the frame at Leicester earlier in the month and should remain competitive off an unchanged mark. Overture completed a four-timer when last seen and isn't out of it either.

selections.comment: Beaten in Listed company back in November, LUNAR ECLIPSE had finished a respectable third in a decent handicap at Newmarket before that. Only 2lb higher today, Kevin Ryan's filly looks on a workable mark and gets the speculative vote in an open contest. Several make their handicap debuts representing powerful yards and the market may offer valuable clues as to the chances of the novice winners Morrophore and Bintjeddah, while Waardah is another worthy of respect.

selections.comment: DIXIELAND BLUES ticks plenty of boxes. A runner-up here on last year's debut, the son of Invincible Spirit finished second once again on his reappearance at Kempton, but he beat a subsequent winner in the process and looks worthy of another chance on the strength of that form. Muhaajim will know more today after a moderate debut effort at Newmarket and he can feature, while Venezuelan is preferred to the penalised Duca Di Lucca of the remainder.

selections.comment: DON PACIFICO ran into a wall of horses at the All-Weather Championships at Newcastle and that effort can be safely ignored. The son of Night Of Thunder won a novices race here at the end of last year and can show his true colours today with normal luck in-running. Handcuffed finished a creditable fourth in a competitive nursery at York last term and can make her presence felt with a similar effort, while Noble Victory has solid form on the all-weather surfaces and could also land a blow.

selections.comment: Caballo De Mar continued his upward trajectory when completing a four-timer over 1m6f here earlier this month and he must enter the reckoning in his current vein of form. However, a further 6lb higher mark and rise in class/trip could be enough to trip the four-year-old up. CHARGING THUNDER supplemented his C&D triumph with a close-up second in a competitive affair at Newbury 16 days ago and James Owen's inmate makes most appeal, closely followed by Cesarewitch runner-up Manxman.

Camzara could be the biggest danger now she steps up from a mile on just her third career start.

selections.comment: ANDERSEN has an appealing pedigree and although he was unsold at 80,000 euros as a breeze-up juvenile, he showed promise when introduced over 1m2f at Chelmsford last month. The son of Kameko ran green and got tired as that race unfolded, but can improve greatly over this shorter trip. Gloriously Sassy and Arabian Force represent high-profile yards and are respected as such. Hymnbook completes the shortlist.

Placed on his last two starts at Wolverhampton, Cosmos Raj is expected to be thereabouts as well.

selections.comment: A switch to patient tactics worked the oracle for Northbound when he coasted home at Wolverhampton last week. However, he is effectively 11lb higher without Cian Horgan's 3lb claim so MISS WILLOWS shades the vote. Simon Whitaker's mare has a 10lb hike of her own to overcome, but she looked one to follow when making all on her seasonal bow at Catterick. The down-in-grade Naval Academy is worth a second look off a career-low mark.

selections.comment: HOW IMPRESSIVE has bounced back to form when runner up the last twice after dropping a long way in the weights and is expected to go one better here. There isn't much competition for the lead here and he could be tough to peg back in first time blinkers with Oisin Murphy booked. Course specialist King Of Ithaca rates a big threat as he arrives in form and was a touch unlucky last time having met trouble. Winter course winner Feel The Need is another who didn't get a clear run here last time but he can make his presence felt if getting a stiff test at the trip.

selections.comment: Former C&D winner ZIGGY'S MISSILE showed the benefit of his reappearance when narrowly getting the better of Sugar Hill Babe last time and is expected to confirm that form back on his favoured tapeta surface. There are a host of threats in this tight contest mainly coming from the top of the weights. Tourist arrives on the back of 3 wins from his last 5 runs and he remains unexposed at 5f. If building on his reappearance run he should be bang there. Lil Guff also made a winning reappearance on turf and she remains very well treated on her old form. If proving as effective back on tapeta she will go close.

selections.comment: Overture got the better of ORCHARD KEEPER last autumn when completing a 4 timer and though she's open to plenty of improvement this year she may struggle to confirm form with that rival on 4lb worse terms conceding a fitness edge. Though the selection was a beaten favourite on reappearance she was given plenty to do that day and has stronger assistance in the saddle today. Dual novice winner Russian Crescendo has seen her form franked on the flat and over hurdles over the winter and is feared most off what looks a lenient opening mark on reappearance.

selections.comment: Though she didn't beat all that much last time it was hard not to be impressed with MORROPHORE'S victory last time and she is taken to defy top weight on handicap debut. She produced a rating 6lb above her opening mark that day and with a further 5lb claimed she will be tough to beat. Bintjeddah sits at the other end of the weights but looks the biggest danger. She showed the benefit of cheekpieces when a novice winner last year and the form of her runner up effort from the front has been boosted since. She looks likely to progress now handicapping back from a break and holds strong claims. My Margie is more exposed than that pair but boasts a fine record on the AW and may complete the places.

The latest one was boosted emphatically by the third last week suggesting that the selection can take a novice of this grade. Aqab ran well behind a useful rival who has followed up on debut and holds each way appeal with improvement likely. Venezuelan has steadily been progressing and completes the list of dangers back from a break for an in form stable.

An opening mark of 82 seriously underestimates both of his runs so far at this venue. Mr Cool had a next time out winner in behind when shedding his maiden tag last time and looks the biggest threat off a 5lb higher mark. Handcuffed has struggled since his debut win but this is his easiest task since and isn't discounted off top weight.

Mr Cool had a next time out winner in behind when shedding his maiden tag last time and looks the biggest threat off a 5lb higher mark. Handcuffed has struggled since his debut win but this is his easiest task since and isn't discounted off top weight.

selections.comment: BERGERAC was disappointing on reappearance but he did meet trouble that day and should come on for the run. He ran well off similar marks in the Portland and Ayr Silver Cup in the autumn and if matching that form should be thereabouts. Many A Star has an excellent course record and is best forgiven his last couple of runs where he met trouble. He is a big threat in an open race where progressive recent course winner Dutch Kingdom also appeals. His autumn form has worked out well and he should build on that winning reappearance.

selections.comment: An excellent staying contest to close the card which may go the way of the hugely progressive CABALLO DE MAR who got the better of Gibside when racking up a 4 timer last time. He's yet to tackle 2m but has improved on every start as his trip is increased and he looked to have plenty in the tank at the finish last time. Charging Thunder has been in good form in both codes and was only narrowly denied on his follow up attempt last time. He is feared most along with Cesarewitch runner up Manxman who has a class edge but may just need this.

selections.comment: Very hard to see past CLERMONT FERRAND who gave weight to and split a pair of useful 3yos who boosted the form last week on debut. If she gets anywhere near that form she will be tough to beat. Lady Kameko has a long absence to overcome but her debut effort has worked out very well and was franked at Group level. She is the biggest danger ahead of the consistent Regal Agenda who could probably do with some rain.

selections.comment: Top weight Questionable is likely to be popular as she proved progressive in the autumn in better races than this. She should be thereabouts if in the same form for her return but may be vulnerable to race fit BEATRICE SHILLING. The selection shaped as if she were finding her level off a sliding mark when runner up on the AW last time and the quickening ground is a big positive on her turf return. She is thrown in on her best novice form last summer and worth chancing. Cymbidium was in good form when last seen in the autumn and is a possible improver this term. She can fight for a place here.

Gloriously Sassy placed behind some more experienced rivals last time and will be the biggest threat while Andersen holds each way claims if building on his AW debut.

selections.comment: COMMANDER OF LIFE is yet to prove his effectiveness on turf but he has had very few tries and will find this easier than his latest races on the AW. He is chosen ahead of Cosmos Raj who returned to form on the AW in the spring and lurks on a dangerous mark. Power Of Gold hinted at a revival off a tumbling mark on reappearance and holds strong claims if building on that though he isn't one to rely on.

selections.comment: MANILA THRILLER isn't open to as much improvement as many of these but she beat some in form rivals last time and may be capable of following up off 3lb higher with a good draw from which to attack. Bowerchalke is arguably open to the most improvement having beat a useful rival who has boosted the form last time and could prove the biggest danger if fit after a break for handicap debut. Profit Refused lost her form in Ireland but the UK handicapper has given her every chance and she's worth a market check with a good jockey booked for stable debut.

selections.comment: FIRST COMPANY is yet to win away from Kempton but he was only narrowly denied by an in form rival last time and could make amends in a weaker contest. Yazaman completed a 4 timer last summer and held his form in defeat afterwards. He looked in need of the run last time but can get involved if coming on for that. The frustrating Dark Kestrel can often flatter to deceive but is dangerously well treated on his AW form and isn't ruled out if getting a stiff test.

selections.comment: RESPIRO SOLITARIO did well to place having refused to settle on his last start and with that form well advertised by the winner since he is taken to shed his maiden tag on reappearance. Cuda Been A Rowlex was off the mark himself last time showing a willing attitude and will be dangerous if getting a stiff test down in trip. The unexposed Zappata is also feared as he showed improved form in this combination of headgear last time when upped to 1m.

selections.comment: Both NORTHBOUND and Miss Willows were impressive winners last time and may have this finale between them. Preference is for the former who was forced wide and given plenty to do last time. Though he's been raised 8lb for that he remains well treated on his old form and can account for the latter who was suited by an aggressive ride last time and has the plum draw from which to attack. Havana Touch is tumbling down the weights and may complete the places behind that pair.
